notes: City of Raleigh, NC — Wake County portion only. Clipped (centroid-within) to Wake GIS's Dissolved Corporate Limits SHORT_NAME='RAL'; 139,977 of 139,980 parcels in the clip also carry the tax CITY code 'RAL'. The small RTP-area sliver in Durham County is not in Wake's data and is not covered. See run_raleigh.py.

One-stop source: Wake County's nightly 'Property' layer (maps.wake.gov Property/Parcels/MapServer/0) has geometry + LAND_VAL/BLDG_VAL + type & use + land class + billing class + exemption on one row per REID/PIN (0 duplicate keys, 0 stacked footprints).

Condos (skill §6c/§6d): units and leasehold improvements have NO polygon. ~13.3k such REIDs (≈$8.0B building value, Nov 2026 roll) are taken from Wake's daily real-estate data file (services.wake.gov/realdata_extracts/RealEstData*.zip, fixed-width) and summed onto their host PIN (first 10 digits of the roll PIN = PIN_NUM, exact key). 641 condo 'MASTER CARD' parcels receive the units. Wake assesses a unit's whole value as building (unit land = $0), so ~616 condo parcels ship with $0 land and the gp-error layer flags them (Providence/Hartford precedent; condos ≈ 6% of taxable value, no land imputed).

Exempt: billing class 'Exempt' (3,190 parcels: city, state/NCSU, county, schools, churches, PHA, LIHTC) and HOA common areas (3,795; assessed at ~$0 under G.S. 105-277.8) are excluded. State-assessed utilities/railroads dropped as Utility. ~$700M of taxable leasehold buildings sitting on exempt land (NCSU Centennial Campus, convention-center block) are dropped with their host parcels.
Wake has no surface-parking land use; type-and-use 21/210 (parking decks) are structures and go through the improvement-ratio test.
link is the Wake County real estate account page (Account.asp?id=<REID>).
